cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

c = itertools.count()
def s(sid, off, h, fin=False): return F("STREAM", id=sid, offset=off, data_hex=h, fin=fin)
def r(sid, size): return F("RESET_STREAM", id=sid, final_size=size)
def C(off, h): return F("CRYPTO", offset=off, data_hex=h)
def P(): return F("PING")
def UNK(): return F("UNKNOWN")
def CL(app, code): return F("CLOSE", app=app, code=code)
def d(packs, t): return dg(t, 1200, packs)
def p(*frames, level="A", pn=None, auth=True): return pkt(level, next(c) if pn is None else pn, list(frames), auth)
def K(t,lvl,act): return key(t,lvl,act)
def oneA(events, **kw): return one([K(0,"A","install")] + events, **kw)

# earlier semantic error beats a later CLOSE in the same packet
v = view(oneA([d([p(s(0,0,"616263",True))],1), d([p(s(0,0,"61",True), CL(True,7))],2)]))
print("err-before-close:", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"], v["rt"])

# LAYOUT after termination
v = view(oneA([d([p(CL(True,4))],2), d([p(P(), level="A", pn=5), p(P(), level="I", pn=6)],3)]))
print("layout-after-close:", v["pk"])

# UNKNOWN vs forbidden frame priority
v = view(oneA([d([p(F("HANDSHAKE_DONE"), UNK())],1)]))
print("hd-then-unknown:", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(oneA([d([p(UNK(), F("HANDSHAKE_DONE"))],1)]))
print("unknown-then-hd:", v["pk"])
v = view(oneA([d([p(s(0,0,"61"), UNK(), F("HANDSHAKE_DONE"))],1)]))
print("stream,unknown,hd:", v["pk"])

# close at Z with early
v = view(one([d([p(CL(True, 5), level="Z", pn=0)],1)], early=True))
print("close at Z:", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["keys"])
# close at Z without early
v = view(one([d([p(CL(True, 5), level="Z", pn=0)],1)]))
print("close at Z noearly:", v["pk"])
# frames at Z
v = view(one([d([p(C(0,"aa"), level="Z", pn=0)],1)], early=True))
print("crypto at Z:", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(one([d([p(P(), level="Z", pn=0)],1)], early=True))
print("ping at Z:", v["pk"])
# I level frames
v = view(one([d([p(s(0,0,"61"), level="I", pn=0)],1)]))
print("stream at I:", v["pk"], v["conn"])
v = view(one([d([p(F("STOP_SENDING", id=0), level="H", pn=0)],1), K(2,"H","install")]))
print("stop at H:", v["pk"])
